desc: Design algorithm: bottom-up DFS tracking dangling path length; deterministic rules at each node (≥3 nonzero children → No; 2 → pair if a+b+1==K; 1 → complete if a+1==K else extend; 0 → return 1 unless K==1)
Verify algorithm on both sample inputs manually
Implement iterative post-order DFS: first pass to get parent/order, second pass in reverse to compute dangling lengths
Handle edge cases: K=1 (always Yes), single vertex (NK=1)
At each node: gather nonzero child dangling values; apply rules (≥3 → No; 2 → check sum+1==K; 1 → extend or complete; 0 → return 1 or 0 if K==1)
Root must have dangling 0 → Yes else No
Use sys.stdin for fast input, adjacency lists; output final code block
Verify edge cases and rooting-independence: NK=1; N=1 non-path tree (star, K=3 → No); 2-child sum mismatch case; deep path graph performance at 2×10⁵ vertices
